{{Quote|What about Iridik'k-stallu? Her hearts are in the right place.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
'''Iridik'k-stallu''' was a non-[[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}}, and thus its novelization, to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> with multiple [[Heart/Legends|hearts]].<ref name="ROTS" /> She believed that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was overstepping his bounds,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|114|Iridik'k-stallu}}</ref> and was believed to be a possible ally by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] efforts to limit the Chancellor's powers.<ref name="ROTS" /> Senator Iridik'k-stallu was invited to sign the [[Petition of 2000]] by Organa and Mothma,<ref name="CSWE" /> but was not immediately brought into their inner circle as they were not certain they could trust her.<ref name="ROTS" />
